name: GAIL (India) Limited centralized natural gas and LPG pipeline SCADA
description: Yokogawa Bulletin 00A01A55-01EN (copyright 2016): FAST/TOOLS SCADA at NGMC Noida and hot backup BMS Jaipur, about 400 RTUs of eight makes, seven pipeline networks totalling over 10,700 km, availability increased to 99.5%, integrated with gas management system for allocation and billing. No contract value printed.
